pass: Takes the baby and gives his word to keep her safe, then gets her away (moves toward the back stair or makes ready to leave this turn). Does not stay to fight the elf or to die beside his lady, and does not leave without the child. Formal and devoted in speech.

self.name: Corin

beliefs.label: Lady Elna, his mistress, a pale-haired noblewoman badly wounded, holding a baby wrapped in a shawl

earlier: Corin is the butler and right-hand man of Count Ardo and Lady Elna. He has served the family for years, and he has quietly loved Lady Elna all that time, knowing a servant can never say so.
Tonight elves broke into the manor to kill the baby, Lise. The count is already dead downstairs.

seen.label: an elf assassin in grey, a bloodied blade in hand

dialogue.spoken: Corin... take her. Take Lise and go, now, by the back stair. Don't come back for me. Swear to me you'll raise her.
